outcome: Hysterosalpingographic (HSG) findings (bilateral tubal blockage, hydrosalpinx, fimbrial adhesions, Asherman's syndrome, bilateral beaded tubes/tubercular salpingitis)
cohort: The study included 2324 Ghanaian women diagnosed with clinical infertility who underwent HSG at a major tertiary center.
finding: Infertility rates among Ghanaian women increased over the years, with primary infertility being significantly more prevalent among younger women, and tubal and cervical abnormalities being the most prevalent HSG findings.
